info.name: GridLine / APEX ATELIER Ecommerce API (v1)
info.description:
Complete Postman Collection v2.1 for the NestJS backend (/api/v1). Covers Auth, Users & Addresses, Categories, Brands, Products, Cart, Checkout & Orders, Payments (Sepolia USDC + COD), Uploads, and Admin Operations (Customers, Inventory, Orders, Payments, Dashboard).

Authentication: Global JwtAuthGuard accepts either HTTP-only cookies (`accessToken`, `refreshToken`) or `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Endpoints marked @Public() do not require authentication.

request.description: Public (`@Public()`). Checks application availability and MongoDB connectivity via active `admin().ping()` (2s timeout). Returns `200 OK` when healthy or `503 Service Unavailable` when MongoDB is down. Never exposes connection strings, secrets, or stack traces.
Public root endpoint (`AppController.getHello`).

Public (`@Public()`). Registers a new customer, sets `accessToken` and `refreshToken` HTTP-only cookies, and returns tokens + user profile.

DTO (`RegisterDto`):
- `firstName` (required, string, max 50)
- `lastName` (required, string, max 50)
- `email` (required, valid email)
- `password` (required, 8-64 chars, >=1 upper, >=1 lower, >=1 digit or special char)

Public (`@Public()`). Authenticates with email & password, sets HTTP-only cookies (`accessToken`, `refreshToken`), and returns tokens + user.

DTO (`LoginDto`): `email` (required), `password` (required).

Public (`@Public()`). Verifies a Google ID token (`credential`) and issues session cookies + JWT tokens.

DTO (`GoogleLoginDto`): `credential` (required, string).
Public (`@Public()`). Reads `refreshToken` from cookie or request body (`RefreshTokenDto`), rotates tokens, and sets new cookies.
Authenticated (`JwtAuthGuard`). Revokes refresh token (from cookie or optional `RefreshTokenDto.refreshToken`) and clears auth cookies.
Authenticated. Returns the current user safe profile.
Authenticated. DTO (`UpdateProfileDto`): all optional (`firstName`, `lastName`, `phone`, `avatar`).
Authenticated. Returns all saved shipping addresses for the current user.
Authenticated. DTO (`CreateAddressDto`): required `label`, `fullName`, `phone`, `line1`, `city`, `state`, `postalCode`; optional `line2`, `country` (default `"US"`), `isDefault` (default `false`).
Authenticated. Marks `:addressId` as the default shipping address.
Authenticated. DTO (`UpdateAddressDto`): all fields optional.
Authenticated. Removes `:addressId` from the user profile.
Public (`@Public()`). Non-admins always receive `active` categories; authenticated admins may pass `status=all|active|inactive`. Optional `page`/`limit` (max 50) enable pagination.
Public (`@Public()`).
Public (`@Public()`).
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). DTO (`CreateCategoryDto`): required `name` (max 100); optional `slug` (kebab-case), `description`, `image` (URL), `parent` (MongoId), `status` (`active|inactive`).
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). DTO (`UpdateCategoryDto`): all fields optional (`parent` can be `null`).
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). Soft-deactivates the category.
Public (`@Public()`). Non-admins receive `active` brands; admins may pass `status=all|active|inactive`. Optional `page`/`limit` (max 50).
Public (`@Public()`).
Public (`@Public()`).
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). DTO (`CreateBrandDto`): required `name`; optional `slug`, `logo` (URL), `description`, `status` (`active|inactive`).
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). DTO (`UpdateBrandDto`): all fields optional.
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). Soft-deactivates the brand.
Public (`@Public()`). Supports `ProductQueryDto` filtering, sorting, and pagination. Admins receive `status` visibility.
Public (`@Public()`).
Public (`@Public()`). `limit` defaults to 4 (clamped 1..20).
Public (`@Public()`).

Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). DTO (`CreateProductDto`): required `name`, `sku`, `category` (MongoId), `brand` (MongoId), `price` (int cents >= 0); optional `slug`, `description`, `compareAtPrice`, `currency`, `images`, `specifications`, `compatibility`, `stock`, `reservedStock`, `lowStockThreshold`, `status` (`draft|published|out_of_stock|archived`), `isFeatured`.
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). `multipart/form-data` using `FileInterceptor("image")`. Optional text fields: `alt`, `isPrimary`.
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). Removes an image by Cloudinary `publicId`.
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). DTO (`UpdateProductDto`): all fields optional.
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). Archives the product.
Authenticated. Returns the current user cart.
Authenticated. DTO (`AddToCartDto`): required `productId` (MongoId); optional `quantity` (int >= 1, default 1).
Authenticated. DTO (`MergeCartDto`): `items` array of `{ productId, quantity }`.
Authenticated. DTO (`UpdateCartItemDto`): required `quantity` (int >= 1).
Authenticated. Removes `:productId` from cart.
Authenticated. Empties the user cart.

Authenticated. Creates an order from the user cart, reserves stock, and sets `paymentExpiresAt` (30 minutes for `crypto_wallet`).

DTO (`CheckoutDto`): required `addressId` (MongoId); optional `paymentMethod` (`crypto_wallet` | `cod`, default `crypto_wallet`), `notes` (max 500), `idempotencyKey` (max 128).
Authenticated. `OrderQueryDto`: `page`, `limit` (max 50), `fulfilmentStatus`, `paymentStatus`.
Authenticated. Returns order details owned by the current user.
Authenticated. Cancels a cancellable order (`placed` + `pending`/`failed`) and releases reserved stock. DTO (`CancelOrderDto`): optional `reason` (max 500).
Public (`@Public()`). Returns active EVM chain (`chainId`, `network`), token (`token`, `tokenAddress`, `tokenDecimals`), `destinationAddress`, and `requiredConfirmations`.

Authenticated. Idempotently creates or returns an active payment attempt (`pending` / `confirming`) for the order.

DTO (`InitiatePaymentDto`): required `orderId` (MongoId), `walletAddress` (EVM `0x` + 40 hex); optional `chainId` (int >= 1).

Authenticated. Verifies an on-chain ERC-20 `Transfer` receipt via JSON-RPC (`BlockchainVerifierService`), checks confirmations (`>= requiredConfirmations`), prevents tx replay across orders, and transitions the order to `paid`.

DTO (`VerifyPaymentDto`): required `orderId` (MongoId), `transactionHash` (`0x` + 64 hex), `walletAddress` (`0x` + 40 hex), `chainId` (int >= 1).
Authenticated. Returns the latest payment attempt for `:orderId` owned by the current user.

Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). `multipart/form-data` using `FileInterceptor("image")`. Optional `folder` (`gridline/brands`, `gridline/categories`, `gridline/products`; defaults to `gridline/products`).
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). `AdminDashboardQueryDto`: `range` (`7d|30d|90d|all`, default `30d`), optional ISO `dateFrom`, `dateTo`.

Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). `AdminCustomerQueryDto`: `page`, `limit` (max 100), `search`, `status` (`all|active|inactive`), `sortBy` (`createdAt|firstName|email|lastLoginAt`), `sortOrder` (`asc|desc`).
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`).
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). DTO (`UpdateCustomerStatusDto`): required `isActive` (boolean).
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). `AdminInventoryQueryDto`: `page`, `limit`, `search`, `stockStatus` (`all|in_stock|low_stock|out_of_stock`), `sortBy`, `sortOrder`.

Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). `InventoryMovementQueryDto`: `page`, `limit` (max 100), `productId` (MongoId), `type` (`initial_stock|admin_adjustment|stock_reservation|reservation_release|order_fulfillment|order_cancellation`).
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). DTO (`AdjustInventoryDto`): required `type` (`increase|decrease`), `quantity` (int 1..100000), `reason` (max 500).
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). `AdminOrderQueryDto`: `page`, `limit` (max 50), `search`, `fulfilmentStatus`, `paymentStatus`.
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`).

Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). DTO (`UpdateOrderStatusDto`): required `fulfilmentStatus` (`processing|shipped|out_for_delivery|delivered|cancelled`); optional `codPaymentReceived` (boolean), `note`, `shippingProvider`, `trackingNumber`, `trackingUrl` (HTTP/HTTPS URL).
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). Returns revenue & attempt summary.

Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). `AdminPaymentQueryDto`: `page`, `limit`, `search`, `status` (`all|verified|paid|pending|confirming|failed|expired`), `paymentMethod` (`all|crypto_wallet|cod`), `dateFrom`, `dateTo`.
Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). Looks up by Payment ID or falls back to COD Order ID.

Admin only (`@Roles("admin")`). Reconciles an `expired` crypto payment that has an on-chain `transactionHash`: `action: "fulfill"` re-reserves stock and marks the order `paid`, or `action: "refund"` records `refundTxHash` (`0x` + 64 hex) and marks both payment and order `refunded`.
